title: 'PM forgiving me is a very big thing': Noida teen who 'abused' Modi apologises again
content: A 15-year-old girl expressed immense relief after Prime Minister Narendra Modi's forgiving message. She felt she received a second chance after making deeply regrettable and offensive statements. The teenager explained she was influenced by others at a protest and later apologized. She is now receiving threats and facing ongoing police inquiries regarding the incident. The girl stated she will not repeat such actions and seeks acceptance of her apology.

title: The promise, the pain and the gold: Asmita Dey's journey to CWG history
content: Asmita Dey's historic Commonwealth Games gold was shaped by far more than what happened on the judo mat. After losing her father, battling a Grade-2 ankle injury and overcoming severe financial hardship, the Tripura judoka found unwavering support in coach Yashapal Solanki, who stood by her like a father. Their emotional embrace after the final told the story of resilience, sacrifice and a dream fulfilled against overwhelming odds.

title: 3 killed in Idaho shopping area shooting; gunman among dead
content: Three people died and two were injured after a gunman opened fire. The shooter was also among the deceased, with authorities investigating the motive. The chaotic scene unfolded near a busy In-N-Out Burger restaurant on Saturday afternoon. Witnesses described seeing an armed individual and people fleeing the area in fear. Law enforcement confirmed the threat to the community was over after the incident.

title: Nuclear plants, Gaza craters: Google pulls AI tool from Google Earth in 24 hours
content: Google has removed its new AI image generation feature from Google Earth. This action followed immediate concerns raised by researchers about disinformation risks. Experts warned the tool could easily create convincing fake satellite imagery for public deception. Google stated they are implementing stronger safeguards while pausing the feature. The company noted generated images were watermarked as AI-created.

title: Friendship day: 30+ greetings and messages to make your best friends feel special
content: Friendship Day 2026 offers a chance to appreciate loved ones.  The article provides numerous messages for different friendship dynamics.  These include wishes for best friends and those living far away.  Funny and heartfelt messages are also included for various relationships.  The article emphasizes that simple gestures often convey deep appreciation.

title: Land mine blast survivor Soman Rana scripts golden CWG story
content: The triumph was particularly significant for Soman Rana, who was a national-level boxer before the accident abruptly ended his sporting career. He had trained alongside Vijender Singh and represented the Services Sports Control Board at 2005 Senior National Boxing Championships.

title: 'Citizens have right to know': Judge Bhuyan questions SC collegium's opacity
content: Justice Ujjal Bhuyan questioned the Supreme Court collegium's lack of transparency in judicial appointments. He noted that recent collegium resolutions provided no reasons for their decisions. This opacity, he argued, could allow unsuitable individuals to enter the judiciary. Citizens possess a right to know deliberations concerning judicial elevations and transfers. The JALDI report highlights varying transparency levels across India's higher courts.

title: When a district in Florida's Everglades used robot rabbits to eliminate Burmese pythons
content: Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic prey using heat and scent to lure snakes. When a python is detected, officials are alerted to remove the invasive species. This technology complements the annual Python Challenge, which has removed thousands of snakes. These efforts aim to control the python population impacting native wildlife.

title: India win seven gold medals to cap record-breaking boxing campaign in CWG
content: India finished on top of the boxing medal standings with seven gold and three silver medals, registering its best-ever performance at the Commonwealth Games.

title: Florida sixth-grader makes soil balls to save water, eyes $25,000 prize
content: An 11-year-old Florida student has reached the finals of a national science competition.  Her innovative soilshade balls help farmers conserve water during dry weather conditions.  This eco-friendly invention slows evaporation and keeps soil moist for extended periods.  She will compete for a $25,000 prize and mentorship from 3M scientists.  The competition celebrates young innovators using STEM to solve real-world problems.

title: Diane Keaton’s $22.9 m LA home sells after 8-year makeover
content: The Los Angeles dream home that legendary Hollywood actor Diane Keaton spent nearly a decade designing and transforming has found a buyer, nine months after the Annie Hall star's death. The property, which was most recently listed for $22.9 million, is now under a contingent offer, meaning a buyer has been found and the sale is moving toward closing.

title: World's largest digital camera captures more than 500,000 galaxies in deep view of universe
content: The Vera C. Rubin Observatory has released a stunning image of the COSMOS field. This image contains over half a million galaxies and fifty thousand stars. Astronomers have studied this specific sky region for over two decades. The observatory's new camera provides unparalleled depth and coverage of the universe. Future observations will reveal even fainter galaxies and cosmic events.

title: India-China border trade resumes after 6 years
content: India and China have reopened two key Himalayan trade routes after six years. Traditional border trade resumed Saturday through Lipulekh and Shipki La passes. Chinese authorities restricted the initial batch of traders to twenty people. Indian traders can export 36 categories of goods, while Chinese traders bring twenty. A new trade mart was also inaugurated near the international border.

title: Passenger vehicle sales hit top gear as dispatches jump 33%; Maruti, Hyundai set records
content: India's passenger vehicle sales saw robust growth in July.  Leading manufacturers like Maruti Suzuki and Hyundai reported record monthly dispatches.  Tata Motors and Mahindra & Mahindra also posted substantial increases in their sales.  This strong momentum was supported by government demand-boosting measures.  Automakers benefited from favorable economic conditions throughout the month.

title: How to get John Wick Sprite in Fortnite: Location, ability, and more
content: Fortnite's new v41.30 update brings the John Wick Sprite exclusively to Reload mode. Players can find this Sprite in normal and special Sprite chests within the game. Eliminating opponents who possess the Sprite also allows for its acquisition by other players. Winning a Victory Royale in Reload mode guarantees the John Wick Sprite for all participants. This Sprite reveals nearby enemies for a short duration after an elimination.

title: Brittany Mahomes shares powerful message on motherhood after $325M success
content: Kansas City Chiefs star Patrick Mahomes' wife, Brittany Mahomes, shared a heartfelt message about motherhood, leadership and the next generation while celebrating another major milestone beyond football. The Kansas City Current co-owner reflected on why she wants her children to see women in leadership as the norm after helping build one of the biggest success stories in women's sports. Here's what Brittany said during her speech, why she was honored, Patrick Mahomes' loving reaction, and how her impact continues to shape opportunities for women on and off the field

title: Michael Jordan’s high school setback that inspired his legendary NBA career
content: Michael Jordan's famous quote emphasizes accepting failure while not accepting inaction. He believed that learning from mistakes is crucial for personal growth and development. Jordan's own career demonstrated this philosophy through numerous setbacks and comebacks. This mindset continues to inspire individuals across various fields and endeavors. The core message highlights the value of effort over the fear of potential failure.

title: 0-5 down, gold at the end: How India boxer turned the tide to win CWG title
content: Ankush Panghal secured the men's 80kg gold medal with a remarkable comeback victory. He overcame a significant deficit to defeat England's Dimeji Shittu in the final bout. This win contributed to India's most successful boxing campaign ever at the Commonwealth Games. India achieved seven gold and three silver medals in total across the boxing events. The women's team notably secured five gold medals during the competition.

title: CWG 2026 medal table: India soar to fourth place after 16-medal blitz
content: India enjoyed its biggest day of the 2026 Commonwealth Games, winning 16 medals to climb to fourth in the standings with one day remaining. A historic boxing haul of seven golds and three silvers led the surge, while medals in para athletics, athletics and judo lifted India's tally to 39 medals (13 gold, 17 silver and nine bronze) in Glasgow.

title: Bengal STF probe Jaish man's plot to create trouble at Jantar Mantar
content: West Bengal Police STF arrested Arpita Sarkar, girlfriend of suspected terrorist Hamim Mondal.  Investigators are probing their alleged plan to create disturbances at Jantar Mantar.  Hamim was reportedly working under instructions from Pakistani handlers via social media.  Arpita is also suspected of involvement in a honey-trap network targeting influential people.  The investigation is ongoing, and more arrests are anticipated in the coming days.

title: Fear stalks Kashmir’s brick kilns after terrorists kill 2 migrant workers
content: Two migrant labourers were killed Friday evening in Kulgam, causing panic among workers. Brick kilns across south Kashmir halted operations as labourers stayed indoors. Many workers expressed concerns about their safety and earning a living. Security forces visited the kilns and assured the labourers of protection. Officials directed authorities to ensure the safety of all migrant workers.

title: E20: AAP plans pro-choice rally to PM residence
content: Arvind Kejriwal announced a march to the Prime Minister's residence on Tuesday. He demanded consumers have a choice between pure petrol and E20 fuel.  Kejriwal also called for E20 fuel to be priced lower than pure petrol.  He challenged the government to release scientific studies supporting the E20 fuel policy.  The AAP leader advised consumers to consider electric vehicles for future transportation needs.

title: 5.9 crore returns filed till July 31 deadline: I-T dept
content: Nearly 5.9 crore income tax returns were filed by the July 31 deadline. This number is lower than last year's extended filing period. Major tax concessions were announced during the last financial year. Taxpayers can still file returns until December with a penalty. Business income filers have different extended deadlines for their submissions.

title: July GST collections up 15.4% to Rs 2.1 L cr on higher imports
content: Goods and Services Tax collections rose 15.4 percent to Rs 2,11,205 crore in July. This increase was largely due to a 29 percent jump in integrated GST on imports. Strong economic activity and higher commodity prices also contributed to the robust tax collections. Central GST mop-up increased 12.3 percent while state GST grew 8.7 percent. Net collections after refunds went up 15.8 percent, reflecting continued economic resilience.

title: UPI transactions touch Rs 76cr/day, FASTag declines
content: UPI processed 2,366 crore transactions in July, showing significant year-on-year growth.  NETC FASTag transactions declined by 6% compared to the previous year.  The value of UPI transactions rose to Rs 29.88 lakh crore in July.  NETC FASTag transaction value also saw a decrease from the prior month.  UPI handled an average of 76.3 crore transactions daily in July.

title: Cloudburst damages structures in Kishtwar; rain halts Amarnath Yatra
content: Flash floods in Kishtwar's Chatroo area damaged shops and houses early Saturday.  Vehicles were washed away, and the national highway sustained damage from debris.  The Amarnath Yatra was suspended from Jammu due to incessant rain.  Schools remained closed in several districts as a precautionary measure.  Affected shopkeepers and business owners will receive government compensation.

title: Vande Bharat’s first organ run delivers heart of hope in Ahmedabad
content: Mithun Swain's heart traveled on a Vande Bharat train after his family donated his organs.  This journey marked India's first organ transport via the express train.  His heart reached Ahmedabad for a life-saving transplant operation.  The railways and Gujarat government coordinated this vital organ delivery.  This act provided a second chance for four individuals.

title: Monsoon hope as WMO sees an El Niño counter
content: India faces a risk of below-normal monsoon rainfall due to El Niño.  A positive Indian Ocean Dipole may offer some relief to the country.  This oceanic pattern could improve rainfall conditions in southern India.  It might prevent the monsoon from slipping into a deficient phase.  International forecasts suggest a positive IOD could develop soon.

title: Long hours hurting resident docs’ mental health, NMC tells SC
content: Resident doctors face significant psychological distress from long working hours.  The National Medical Commission acknowledged these demanding schedules impact their health.  The commission stated reasonable working hours are essential for doctor and patient wellbeing.  However, NMC expressed inability to enforce this, citing health authorities' domain.  A doctors' group highlighted rising suicide cases due to these conditions.

title: Railway Board panels suggest premature retirement of 5 officers
content: Railway Board committees recommended premature retirement for five Group A officers. This action targets corruption, lack of integrity, and inefficiency within the service. Two senior administrative grade officers and three junior administrative grade officers were affected. These decisions were made under the Indian Railway Establishment Code provisions. Previously, thirty-two officers were retired in 2022 for similar reasons.

title: CBI files EPFO cheating case against Anil Ambani
content: The CBI has filed a cheating case against Reliance Capital and Anil Ambani. This action stems from an alleged Rs 1,816 crore loss to the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation. EPFO invested Rs 2,500 crore in Reliance Capital’s debentures which later defaulted. While the issue was settled earlier, ED findings prompted a new fraud case. Anil Ambani denies any wrongdoing in this matter.

title: 6 killed in Kerala as heavy rain triggers landslides, floods; IMD issues red alert
content: Heavy rains lashed Kerala on Saturday, causing landslides and widespread flooding. Six people died in rain-related incidents, with several others rescued from affected areas. Authorities launched large-scale rescue and evacuation operations, setting up numerous relief camps for displaced residents. Landslides and flooding disrupted traffic and damaged many houses across several districts. The India Meteorological Department issued red and orange alerts for multiple districts forecasting heavy rainfall.

title: RTI activist seeks probe into Dipke's father's finances; flags Rs 1cr CJP defence fund
content: An RTI activist has requested an inquiry into the finances of CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke's father. He also wrote to authorities regarding Kapil Sibal's announced legal defence fund. The activist questioned the unregistered CJP's operation as a political party. He asked the Election Commission to verify the CJP's registration status. The activist also asked GST authorities to check tax on Sibal's pledged amount.

title: 'Screams, sudden death': 16-year-old girl's body exhumed 52 days after burial in UP
content: A 16-year-old girl's body was exhumed fifty-two days after her burial in Aligarh. Suspicious circumstances surrounding her death prompted the district administration to order a fresh investigation. A local resident alleged hearing screams and later learned of the girl's sudden death. Following his complaint and death threat claims, authorities ordered the exhumation for examination. The body has now been sent for a post-mortem as police begin their detailed inquiry.

title: 'Disappointed with PM Modi': Shehzad Poonawalla’s sarcastic 'dictator' jibe at oppn
content: Taking a jibe at PM Modi's critics, Shehzad Poonawalla expressed "disappointment" with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's leadership style.  He sarcastically suggested Modi learn dictatorship from past Congress leaders.  Poonawalla cited Indira Gandhi and Jawaharlal Nehru as examples of strong rule.  He also mentioned past Congress governments' actions during protests.  The former spokesperson concluded Modi had not met Left-liberal expectations.

title: 'Weaker, stronger, peter out': Mixed messages complicate Trump's Iran exit plan
content: US President Trump is receiving conflicting advice from two key regional allies on how to handle Iran. Saudi Arabia is urging restraint and de-escalation to prevent a wider regional conflict, while Israel is pressing for a tougher stance against Tehran. Meanwhile, tensions continue to rise, with attacks on commercial shipping and drone strikes in Kuwait adding to regional instability. Trump has expressed frustration over stalled diplomatic efforts and Iran's refusal to meet US demands.

title: Gold rush: Arundhati Choudhary wins India's fifth boxing gold at CWG 2026
content: Arundhati defeated Reid by a unanimous 5-0 decision to give India its fifth boxing gold of the competition.

content: However, Vinoth told TOI that the document in his possession was only the “budget preface and not the complete budget document.”

title: Bhogapuram airport built six months ahead of schedule: GMR Group Chairman
content: The GMR group has constructed the new airport at Bhogapuram, the native district of Mr. Rao. The GMR group has constructed the airport six months in advance of the deadline of December, he said.

title: Narendra Modi all praise for Bobbili Veena artisans
content: Bobbili Veena is crafted in the heritage city of Bobbili in Vizianagaram district. The instrument has gained nationwide prominence due to patronage from great musicians across the country.

content: The new international airport will open up unprecedented opportunities in investment, tourism, trade, industry and employment, while placing the region prominently on the global map, says Rammohan Naidu

title: Digital medical emergency referral system set to transform patient care in Rajasthan
content: Rajasthan is the first State in the country to implement the model, in which a referred patient’s medical history will reach the control room online before they arrive at the hospital

content: The announcement comes months after the Lok Bhavan and the elected government were at loggerheads over the eviction drive in Jammu’s Sunjwan, Bathindi, Raika, and Sidhra areas in Jammu

content: Mr. Adhikari reiterated that ISKCON follows a tradition of serving pure vegetarian food and that the State government had no intention of asking the organisation to alter its practices

content: The reforms are aimed at making the process more convenient for the candidates, according to the Union Health Ministry; a total of 2,73,183 candidates have registered for NEET (PG) 2026 which will be conducted in a single shift across around 340 cities and more than 1,300 examination centres

content: The new tank at Thammanam was proposed following the partial collapse of the 1.35-crore-litre water tank, which had triggered a temporary drinking water crisis in the city

content: Eight families comprising 26 people were shifted to a relief camp after floodwaters entered houses at Peratta Thottipalam in Ulikkal grama panchayat

title: No evidence of EVM tampering, says poll official on fourth day
content: “This is not re-counting. This is EVM Checking and Verification process,” Chennai District Election Officer and Greater Chennai Corporation Commissioner G.S. Sameeran said. “It is a 100% transparent exercise to establish the reliability of the EVMs.”

title: Protection for certain royal estates from succession law still valid despite abolition of privy purses and privileges: Karnataka High Court
content: The court holds that while the purport and object of the Gaddi or ceremonial throne has lost its relevance, from the customary practical perspective, it is still a relevant subject

title: Kerala CM Satheesan’s chopper journey draws flak from CPI(M)
content: Satheesan reportedly flew aboard the helicopter from Thiruvananthapuram to Kochi to visit his father-in-law, who was undergoing treatment. As Leader of the Opposition, he had criticised the then LDF government for its “extravagance” in hiring the helicopter.

title: Why fishers in Kerala ignore dire warnings and venture into sea
content: For many fisher families, heightened risk at sea remains secondary to the immediate threat of starvation on land. Government issues ‘stay-at-home’ directives in extreme weather conditions, but no minimum wages or guaranteed compensation is offered, leaving the fishers shorn of livelihood, say their union leaders

title: ‘Every effort being made to maximise Godavari waters for farmers’ benefit’

title: How monsoon ready is Chennai?
content: As Chennai begins the countdown to the Northeast monsoon, the city confronts the twin challenges of a weak Southwest monsoon, followed by prospects of intense rainfall during the ensuing monsoon. An additional factor this year, El Nino, adds to the uncertainty. But the focus of the local government must always remain on making sure the city is monsoon ready

content: Organised by the Thiruvananthapuram district committee of the AKSTU, the protest demanded that the Union and the State governments abandon moves to “weaken” the public education sector

title: Punjab’s Dalits power politics with the purse
content: For generations, caste hierarchy in rural Punjab was written into society’s architecture, much like in other parts of India. Guru Ghar in Chak Hakim village of Phagwara is seen as a symbol of rising social, economic, religious, and political assertiveness of the Dalits, finds Vikas Vasudeva. title: Government approves 2 tunnels for Valley-Jammu connectivity
content: government approves two strategic tunnel projects and the approach roads on NH-244 in J&K at an estimated cost of around Rs 9,800 crore . the projects comprise Singhpora-Vailoo tunnel and Sudhmahadev-Dranga tunnel, along with their approach roads, on the Anantnag-Chenani corridor . these are expected to strengthen road connectivity in Doda, Kishtwar and Udhampur districts .
